en: Illustrated Art Nouveau style postcard depicting a fashionable woman indoors. She wears a long yellow dress and an opulent fur coat with an ermine-like lining, standing on a tiled floor beside a small round wooden side table that holds a tall slender glass vase with a single flowering stem. The background is a simple, stylized wall with a patterned panel on the left. The lower half of the card is blank for writing.
